texts.preamble: Dharmendra Ghanshayamdas Hasani vs The State Of Maharashtra on 9 March, 2022 Author: Vibha Kankanwadi Bench: Vibha Kankanwadi In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad 904 Anticipatory Bail Application No.252 Of 2022 Dharmendra Ghanshayamdas Hasani Versus The State Of Maharashtra ... Mr. C.C. Deshpande, Advocate for the applicant Mr. V.M. Kagne, App for the respondent ... Coram : Smt. Vibha Kankanwadi, J. Date : 09th March, 2022
texts.facts: 2 Learned APP strongly opposes the application for grant of any interim relief, on the ground that the matter is coming for the first time and he is yet to receive the papers. Contents of the First Information Report shows active involvement of the present applicant. 3 Perusal of the First Information Report would show that the applicant was not present at the spot with contraband articles, but it has been stated that those articles containing Gutkha which is banned in Maharashtra 2 ABA_252_2022 was caught by Jalgaon Police by Special Unit on Nizar-Nandurbar road. Further, it appears that during the course of the investigation it was found out that those articles were stored in the godown of the present applicant within the jurisdiction of Gujrat State. Learned Advocate for the applicant submits that Gutkha is not a banned article in Gujrat State.
